name: threshold
description: Garmin MCP server: connect Garmin Connect to Claude, ChatGPT and any AI assistant. Readiness, HRV, training load and FIT analysis, free on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin Personal API key. Create one at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken

ACCESS_KEY.description: A password you make up, 20+ characters (let your password manager generate one). You type it once per app you connect.

DB.description: Your private archive of Garmin data (D1).

OAUTH_KV.description: OAuth clients and tokens, plus the cached Garmin token (KV).
